title: United Airlines Resolves System Outage That Held Departures; Travelers Urged to Check Flight Status
excerpt: United Airlines resolved a technology issue Monday evening that held departing mainline flights for about an hour. Flights already in the air and United Express flights were not affected, and the airline said there is no indication it was a cybersecurity issue. Travelers are urged to check their flight status.
content:
United Airlines says it has resolved a technology issue that held departing mainline flights on Monday evening, Nov. 16, after a widespread system outage kept planes at the gate for about an hour.

The outage affected the data crews need before takeoff, including aircraft weight and balance information. United said the issue delayed departures but had no impact on flights already in the air or on United Express flights.

The airline said there is no indication the outage was a cybersecurity-related issue. The cause has not been established, and United has not confirmed whether it is connected to the nationwide air traffic control disruption on Friday, Nov. 13.

That earlier disruption, a Federal Aviation Administration ground stop, halted U.S. departures for more than four hours and led to thousands of cancellations and delays over the weekend. Monday's outage came just days before the busy Thanksgiving travel week.

Passengers traveling with United are encouraged to check their flight status in the airline's app or on its website before heading to the airport.

Source: United Airlines; The Associated Press; CNN; NBC News, Nov. 16, 2026.
